simple.meaning: גֶּשֶׁם (geshem) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a shower.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 35 times across Genesis, Leviticus, 1 Kings, 2 Kings, Ezra, and 12 more, beginning at Genesis 7:12. Its contexts include family line, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גֶּשֶׁם (H1653).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: גֶּשֶׁם (geshem) / H1653 is traced through Genesis 7:12, Genesis 8:2, Leviticus 26:4, 1 Kings 17:7 as a generated source-based concept entry.
